description: Start here. Returns `asks`, a short list of things a person can ask, each with the tools it starts from (give your user the asks when they ask what you can do); `groups`, every tool this seat can call by name, grouped by product area with one line each; and under `held` the actions only a person can do (sending, money, access), each with the reason and where in the app. Pass group: "<group>" for that group in full (each tool's whole description, every argument with its allowed values, whether it changes anything, what it obeys, and its actions agents cannot do yet under not_lent), or "all" for everything. Pass schemas: [tool names] to get each named tool its exact input schema (inputSchema) before calling it.
name: catalog
title: What can I do
